did: Home now does its half of several of today's Studio stories. It keeps the notes you leave on an episode and files them for the mailbox. It gives the phone each episode's chapters. When you ask from the phone, it makes a short preview of a template from its sample, under the lane, and clears it away after a day. make promo now plays the release's own sound cues from home's brand folder, and it no longer fails on curl inside the dev shell. The render worker's test no longer goes red on a busy runner, because it keeps its own time. The steward and CLAUDE.md now say a session leaves its clip and its note before it is archived.
